title: Shri Sai Industries v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad (Lucknow Bench)
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Manjive Shukla, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; fresh Clause 6.5 application; reasoned order in eight weeks; coercive measures stayed.
headnote: Industrial consumer relegated to a fresh application under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Authorities directed to hear and pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within eight weeks; coercive measures stayed until then. Merits of the supply dispute not examined.
facts: Shri Sai Industries, through its proprietor Sikha Sinha, approached the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court in a writ petition against the State of Uttar Pradesh (Energy Department) and two others. Counsel were heard. The order does not record the underlying electricity dispute. The Court disposed of the petition by requiring a fresh Clause 6.5 application and a time-bound, reasoned decision after hearing, with a stay of coercive action until then.

holding_units.holding: A writ petitioner in a Supply Code dispute may be directed to make a fresh application under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within a week; if made, the authorities must grant a hearing and pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within eight weeks, and no coercive measure is to be taken until that order.
